Top 10 Best Vans for a DIY Campervan Conversion

By Gumtree Editorial Team

6 October 2026 15 min read

Copy to Clipboard

SHARE

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by

Instaread

It starts innocently enough. Maybe you spent your summer holidays on a campsite, casually strolling past other people’s setups under the guise of walking the dog, secretly taking notes on pop-top roofs, sliding door kitchens, and custom oak worktops. Or perhaps your YouTube algorithm has slowly morphed into a non-stop feed of insulation tutorials, 12V electrical diagrams, and atmospheric “tour my self-converted van” videos.

Either way, you’ve hit the tipping point. The daydream of waking up to coastal views with a fresh stovetop coffee is no longer just an abstract idea – it’s a project waiting to happen.

Choosing the right base vehicle is the most critical decision in any self-build project. To help you make the right choice, here are the top 10 best vans a for a DIY campervan conversion.

10. Vauxhall Vivaro

If you’re looking for a daily driver that easily fits into standard UK supermarket parking spaces and height-restricted car parks, the Vauxhall Vivaro is a brilliant entry point. Extremely common across the UK, it offers squarer interior dimensions than older mid-sized vans, making battening, insulating, and wall panelling straightforward.

Key features: 

  • Daily Driver Compatibility: Compact footprint with a height under 2 metres (in H1 variants), easily passing under UK car park barriers.
  • Square Load Bay: Straighter sidewalls compared to rounded rivals, simplifying insulation and cladding installation.
  • Plentiful UK Stock: Wide availability on the UK used market makes finding clean donor vehicles and cheap replacement parts easy.

Gumtree tip: When inspecting 2.0L dCi models, check for seized fuel injectors – water ingress from the windshield scuttle panel can pool around the injectors over time, making them notoriously difficult and expensive to extract if replacement is required.

9. Renault Master

For DIY builders who want the internal width of a large van without paying the hefty price tag associated with German brands, the Renault Master is a hidden gem. Its wide body shape allows many campervan builders under 6ft tall to fit a fixed bed transversely (widthways across the back), saving massive amounts of living space inside the layout.

Key features: 

  • Transverse Sleeping Layout: Wide rear load area allows side-to-side sleeping configurations for taller adults without needing body flares.
  • Cost-to-Space Ratio: Offers large-van internal volume at a significantly lower purchase price than a Sprinter or Crafter.
  • Low Loading Floor: Front-wheel-drive configuration means a lower floor level, maximising internal standing headroom inside H2 variants.

Gumtree tip: Test the gearbox thoroughly during your test drive. Pay close attention to 2nd and 3rd gear syncros and listen for whining noises, as well as checking for excessive play in the gear selector cables on higher-mileage ex-fleet models.

Find a Renault Master on Gumtree today

8. Ford Transit Custom

The Ford Transit Custom is Britain’s best-selling van for good reason. Driving one feels much closer to driving a modern family hatchback than a commercial vehicle. For a medium-sized camper project with pop-top potential, the Transit Custom offers excellent cab comfort, sharp modern styling, and an unmatched network of UK mechanics and spare parts suppliers.

Key features: 

  • Car-Like Ergonomics: Superior cab comfort, modern driver controls, and responsive handling for long UK road trips.
  • Massive Aftermarket Support: Pre-cut ply kits, pop-top roofs, and custom furniture units are widely available specifically for this model.
  • High Resale Demand: One of the most sought-after medium camper platforms in the UK, making finished builds easy to sell on.

Gumtree tip: Check the service history carefully for wet belt maintenance on 2.0L EcoBlue engines. Wet belts require strict oil change intervals using correct specs; failure to change the oil on schedule causes belt degradation and catastrophic engine failure.

Find a Ford Transit Custom on Gumtree today

7. Iveco Daily

If your dream is a heavy-duty, off-grid adventure rig or a full-time tiny home on wheels, the Iveco Daily is built like a truck. Constructed on a heavy commercial ladder-frame chassis, this van can handle heavy timber builds, massive lithium battery banks, large water tanks, and off-road camper gear without ever sweating over payload limits.

Key features: 

  • Unbeatable Payload: Heavy-duty ladder chassis frame easily handles heavy off-grid builds without exceeding weight limits.
  • Rear-Wheel Drive & Towing: Exceptional rear traction and towing capability for pulling trailers, boats, or motorbike racks.
  • Enormous Internal Volume: Available in massive lengths and heights, perfect for full-time van lifers needing maximum storage.

Gumtree tip: Inspect the ladder chassis frame thoroughly for rust or structural rot using a torch, especially on older models or ex-utility fleet vehicles that spent years driving on salted UK winter roads.

Find a Iveco Daily on Gumtree today

6. Mercedes-Benz Vito

The Mercedes Vito is a premium compact option for those who want smooth motorway cruising and German engineering in a mid-sized package. It’s ideal for a sleek day-van or weekend camper conversion with a rock-and-roll bed setup, offering refinement and brand prestige without the physical footprint of a large Sprinter.

Key features: 

  • Refined Motorway Cruiser: Smooth suspension, quiet cabin insulation, and strong engine performance for long-distance cruising.
  • Low Profile Convenience: Fits comfortably under standard UK parking barriers and navigates tight country lanes effortlessly.
  • Rear or All-Wheel Drive Options: Offers great driving dynamics and optional 4MATIC setups for winter adventures.

Gumtree tip: Examine the lower door edges, sills, and wheel arches for corrosion on older Vito models (pre-2014), and ensure the rear air suspension (if fitted on higher-spec models) inflates and deflates cleanly without air leaks.

Find a Mercedes-Benz Vito on Gumtree today

5. Ford Transit

The full-size Ford Transit is an iconic staple on UK roads. It offers vast internal volume, high roofs, and a boxy shape that makes framing out walls and overhead lockers simple. Because almost every mechanic in the UK knows how to work on a Transit, repairs and replacement parts are inexpensive and easy to source anywhere in the country.

Key features: 

  • Ubiquitous Parts & Service: Any garage in the UK can service and repair a Transit quickly with cheap off-the-shelf spare parts.
  • High Roof Clearance: Excellent standing headroom in H2 and H3 variants for tall camper builders.
  • Spacious Interior Shape: Square sides make framing, insulating, and mounting custom furniture straightforward.

Gumtree tip: Rust remains a key point of check on Transits. Get under the van to inspect the chassis rails, sills, rear suspension mounts, and floor pan thoroughly for deep rust before committing to a purchase.

Find a Ford Transit on Gumtree today

4. Volkswagen Transporter (T5 / T6)

The VW Transporter is the definitive icon of UK campervan culture. Choosing a T5 or T6 opens up the single largest campervan aftermarket support network in the world. From off-the-shelf CNC-cut furniture modules to bolt-on pop-top roofs and swivelling seat bases, converting a VW Transporter is as close to building with adult Lego as van life gets.

Key features: 

  • Unrivalled Resale Value: Holds its market value exceptionally well compared to all other commercial vehicles in the UK.
  • Plug-and-Play Conversions: Endless availability of pre-fabricated furniture kits, pop-tops, and tailored upholstery setups.
  • Thriving Community: Massive UK club scene, specialist garages, and endless advice forums for DIY builders.

Gumtree tip: On 2.0 TDI models (especially the Biturbo/180bhp variants), ask for proof of oil consumption checks and EGR valve updates, as early EGR cooler failure can cause internal engine wear.

Find a Volkswagen Transporter on Gumtree today

3. Volkswagen Crafter

The Volkswagen Crafter represents the modern gold standard for high-end, large-van conversions. Featuring near-vertical sidewalls, exceptional build quality, and driver assistance technology usually reserved for luxury passenger cars, it is the preferred base vehicle for modern off-grid conversions and full-time road trippers.

Key features: 

  • Modern Driver Tech: Packed with safety features, adaptive cruise control, and modern cab ergonomics.
  • Straight-Sided Body: Minimal body curve makes window fitting, wall insulation, and bed construction much easier.
  • Factory 4MOTION Options: Excellent four-wheel-drive capability for off-grid winter camping and wild spots.

Gumtree tip: Check for a fully documented main dealer service history, particularly concerning the DPF (Diesel Particulate Filter) system and automatic transmission servicing (if equipped with the 8-speed DSG box).

Find a Volkswagen Crafter on Gumtree today

2. Mercedes-Benz Sprinter

The Mercedes-Benz Sprinter is the undisputed king of the global van life movement. Renowned for its heavy-duty reliability, powerful engines, and impressive internal length, the Sprinter is the ultimate canvas for a complete home on wheels. Whether you want a full wet room shower, a fixed king-sized bed, or an extensive solar setup, the Sprinter’s cavernous load space handles it with ease.

Key features: 

  • Pro-Grade Longevity: Heavy-duty engines built to easily achieve hundreds of thousands of miles with proper maintenance.
  • Huge Living Area: Long-wheelbase (LWB) and Extra-Long (ELWB) models allow full home amenities (shower, toilet, fixed bed, kitchen).
  • Massive Inspiration Pool: As the most popular conversion platform online, thousands of detailed build guides and wiring plans exist specifically for the Sprinter.

Gumtree tip: Examine older Sprinters carefully for body rust around door seams and panel joins. Mechanically, listen for “black death” – a copper washer leak around the fuel injectors under the engine cover that creates a hard black carbon buildup.

Find a Mercedes-Benz Sprinter on Gumtree today

1. Fiat Ducato

There is a reason professional European motorhome manufacturers build over 70% of their motorhomes on this exact chassis: it is uniquely wide and boxy. The interior load bay width allows virtually anyone under 6ft 2in to sleep widthways (transversely) without needing body flare extensions. This single feature saves up to 50cm of length inside your build, freeing up massive room for a full kitchen, seating area, or wet room bathroom.

Key features: 

  • Widest Load Bay in Class: Allows transverse (side-to-side) bed layouts, saving precious interior floor space.
  • Boxy, Flat Profile: Vertical side walls and near-90-degree corners make floor-to-ceiling cabinet fitting and insulation simpler than any other van.
  • Front-Wheel Drive Efficiency: Eliminates the driveshaft tunnel through the floor, lowering the deck height for maximum standing room inside.

Gumtree tip: Check the gearbox action smoothly in reverse, as well as 5th and 6th gears (a known wear point on high-mileage older models). Ensure timing belt/water pump service intervals have been strictly adhered to on 2.3L Multijet engines.

Find a Fiat Ducato on Gumtree today

Final Checklist Before Buying Your Base Van

  1. Check the MOT History Online: Enter the registration on the UK Government MOT history site to view past advisories regarding rust, suspension, or brake wear.
  2. Calculate Your Payload: Keep your total build weight (including passengers, water, fuel, and gear) under the vehicle’s 3.5-tonne (3,500kg) Gross Vehicle Weight limit to remain legal on a standard UK driver’s license.
  3. Verify ULEZ & Clean Air Zone Compliance: If you plan to drive into London or other UK clean air zones (Birmingham, Bristol, Manchester, etc.), ensure the van meets Euro 6 emissions standards (generally 2016 onwards for diesel) to avoid daily charges.
